artist-11715.title: Siderunners
artist-11715.content:
Siderunners, one of Hungary's most popular DJs, known for his uncompromising, hard-hitting sets.

Biography:

Balázs has been creating in the world of electronic music for more than 10 years.

His main musical direction has been hardstyle since 2012, under the name “Siderunners”. Earlier, as a duo, they won several DJ and producer competitions in Hungary and appeared as performers at bigger and bigger events – since then they have become the most defining hardstyle formation in the Hungarian electronic music scene. By now Dániel has left the music career behind, and Balázs continues to spread the style on his own.

He has already performed in the most renowned clubs and open-air event venues in Hungary, such as PartyStrand in Siófok, the Liget Club, the RIO Café, the RIO XXL stage, and also at Eventhouse Leobersdorf in Austria.

He has played on the same stage with the biggest names of the hard dance scene, among others Headhunterz, Psyko Punkz, Paul Elstak, Malice, Brennan Heart, and Art of Fighters. Thousands of young people have already partied to his energetic, hard, yet still danceable sets.

artist-11705.title: Subrage
artist-11705.content:
Subrage is a Hungarian DJ and music producer who has been moving in the world of electronic music since his teenage years. Under the name Subrage he has been active since 2019, and within a short time he became a defining figure on the hardstyle scene. His emotional, energetic performances are built on the euphoric and rawphoric hardstyle styles – one of the most popular and most powerful directions of the genre.

During his career he has performed at such prominent venues and festivals as Bass Paradise Festival, Akvárium Klub, Analog Music Hall, A38 Hajó, Cinema Hall, Arzenál Klub, Jate Klub, Nagyerdei Víztorony, as well as Festivalna Dvorana Lent.

Over the years Subrage has shared the stage with genre icons such as Brennan Heart, D-Block & S-Te-Fan, Noisecontrollers, Hard Driver, D-Sturb, Sound Rush, Atmozfears, DJ Isaac, Adjuzt, Warface, Da Tweekaz, Aftershock, Vertile and Equalizer, further strengthening his position as one of the rising performers of the hard dance scene.

In 2024 he won the Best Hungarian Hardstyle DJ of the Year award, while his track „In The Ground” became the Best Hungarian Hardstyle Track of the Year. He repeated this success in 2025: he was voted Best Hungarian Hardstyle DJ of the Year again, and his anthem „Rise Together” also won the Best Hungarian Hardstyle Track of the Year award. These recognitions are defining milestones of his career and confirm his place in the domestic hardstyle elite.

artist-12812.title: Sunshine State
artist-12812.content: I first stood behind the decks in 2002, and in 2006 I founded Klubbbass Djz with a friend, back then still playing Hands Up music at the parties. I date the official start of Sunshine State to 2012, which initially as a formation and later as a solo project toured Hungary's biggest clubs as well as several venues abroad. Although my project mainly dealt with minimal and techno music, my love was always Hardstyle, which I am now diving into with the same quality approach as I did previously in other genres. My motto is hard dynamics, melody and harmony.
